tools.name: create_screenshot_batch
tools.description: Render a list of web pages in a real browser. Returns a batch id to poll. The first 10 screenshots each month are free, metered per network address rather than per key, so issuing another key does not reset them. Beyond that the batch pauses and reports how many credits it needs.

tools.name: get_screenshot_batch
tools.description: Read the state and per URL results of a batch created by this client, including the download URL once anything has rendered.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Screenshot credits and free monthly allowance remaining for the calling identity.

tools.name: list_sample_captures
tools.description: Public sample captures this service refreshes on a schedule. Useful for showing a user what the output looks like before they spend anything.

tools.name: create_credit_checkout
tools.description: Create a hosted Stripe Checkout URL for a prepaid credit pack. This can lead to a charge, but only after the user opens the URL and confirms payment on Stripe. Ask the user before calling it and never handle card details.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_credit_checkout" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create a hosted Stripe Checkout URL for a prepaid credit pack. This can lead to a charge, but only after the user opens the URL and confirms payment on Stripe. …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
